Container.Name: Paperclip-Upstream
Container.Overview: Manage teams of AI agents, tasks, approvals, schedules and budgets with Paperclip. This community-maintained Unraid template runs the official upstream image with embedded PostgreSQL and persistent storage. Before starting, set Public URL to the actual browser address and generate two separate secrets using openssl rand -hex 32. Open the WebUI, create your account and claim the first administrator. No external database or model API key is required to start the dashboard. Configure agent credentials separately after setup. Intended for a trusted private network. Remote Hermes agents connect through the Hermes Gateway adapter. Enable Autostart in the Unraid Docker tab after completing setup. See the README for installation, backups and upgrades.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Host port for the dashboard. If changed, update Public URL to match. Keep the container port at 3100.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, uploads, workspaces, configuration and encryption key. Use a dedicated directory on local storage, preferably an SSD pool. Back up the entire directory.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Required: the exact URL used in your browser, including scheme and host port. For example http://tower:3100 or https://paperclip.example.com. Do not enter [IP] or [PORT] placeholders here.

Config.Name: Authentication secret
Config.Description: Required: generate a unique value with openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it unchanged across restarts and include it in your private backup.

Config.Name: Tool action signing secret
Config.Description: Required: run openssl rand -hex 32 again for a separate signing secret. Keep it unchanged across restarts and include it in your private backup.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Keep the upstream default 1000. Embedded PostgreSQL needs writable native-library files owned by this image user; remapping to Unraid UID 99 fails in the tested upstream release.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Keep the upstream default 1000. The entrypoint sets Appdata ownership and runs the application without root. This image uses USER_GID, not PGID.

Config.Name: Additional hostnames
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated hostnames beyond the Public URL host. Enter hostnames only, without scheme, port or wildcard.

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: Container listen address. Leave at 0.0.0.0 for Docker bridge networking.

Config.Name: Container port
Config.Description: Internal application port. Keep at 3100; change the host-side WebUI port instead.

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Internal persistent data directory. Keep aligned with the Appdata container path.

Config.Name: Deployment mode
Config.Description: Require user login. Keep authenticated for network access.

Config.Name: Deployment exposure
Config.Description: Private network deployment with embedded PostgreSQL. Public mode requires a different deployment architecture; see upstream documentation.
